card_config.value: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_set: SPECIAL BOOSTER PACK That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime [UE20BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 Switch to active. May move to the front line.
[When Attacking] If is on your field, choose one of the following:
・You may place one card from your hand into your sideline. If you do, play up to one purple card with 1 or less required energy and [Team Reborn] affinity from your sideline set to resting onto your field.
・Choose up to one other character on your field. It gains 2000 BP until the end of the turn.
・This character gains 1000 BP and 【Impact (1)】 until the end of the turn.
